title: (see EFSB 17-05) Petition of Vineyard Wind LLC Pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 72 for Approval to Construct, Operate, and Maintain a New 220-kV and 115-kV Transmission Line in Massachusetts for the Delivery of Energy from an Offshore Wind Energy Facility Located in Federal Waters to an NSTAR Electric (d/b/a Eversource Energy) Switching Station Located in the Town of Barnstable, Massachusetts.
